question: How was [TEPAH][ATA] synthesized: amounts of TEPA and ATA, solvent, stirring time and evaporation temperature?
expect: 0.0125 mol TEPA and 0.0125 mol ATA in 30 mL ethanol/water (4:1 v/v), stirred 12 h at room temperature, rotary evaporated at 60 C under vacuum (sec. 2.2)
rendered:
=== Amino-Functionalized Ionic Liquid Phase Change Absorbents for Efficient CO2 Capture, page 2 ===

The amino-functionalized ionic liquid [TEPAH][ATA] was prepared by a one-step synthesis. In a typical procedure, 0.0125 mol of TEPA and 0.0125 mol of ATA were dissolved in 30 mL of ethanol/water (4:1 v/v) solution. The mixture was magnetically stirred at room temperature for 12 h, then rotary evaporated at 60 °C under vacuum to remove excess solvent.
